item.title: Huge volume of potholes, 14th August
item.description:
There are a huge volume of potholes in the road opposite Reddings Park. Due to the increased volume of buses using the road the potholes are increasing in size and number. It is incredibly dangerous for cyclists to use the road due to the potholes, I hit one this morning which nearly took me off my bike. Action needs to be taken as a priority before someone is injured - or worse
